description_en: You can invoke the CancelAttendedTransfer API to cancel an attended transfer. You can call this API at any time after initiating the attended transfer and before completing it, even if the transferee has already answered the call
description_zh: 调用CancelAttendedTransfer取消咨询转接，在发起咨询转接后，完成咨询转接前，均可调用该接口取消咨询转接，即使被转接方已经接通，也可以取消
kebab_example: aliyun ccc cancel-attended-transfer --instance-id ccc-test --user-id agent@ccc-test --device-id device --job-id job-65382141036850000 --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CancelAttendedTransfer

parameters.help_en: The Device ID. This parameter is meaningless and can be filled with any value
parameters.help_zh: 设备ID，无意义，可以随便填写
parameters.name: device_id
